Keywords: awareness discover brand problem recognition reach impressions cold audience
Goal: Introduce brand to strangers who don't know you exist. Make them aware of their problem or your category.
Content Types: Blog posts, social media posts, short videos, podcasts, PR, infographics, TikTok/Reels
CTAs: Learn More, Explore, Read the Guide, Watch Now
Metrics: Reach, impressions, brand search volume, new visitors, video views, social followers
Channels: SEO, social media, YouTube, PR, podcast, paid awareness ads (CPM)
Message Framework: Focus on the PROBLEM, not your solution. Educate, entertain, or inspire. No hard sell. Build curiosity.

Keywords: interest engage educate nurture problem aware solution curious top of funnel
Goal: Turn curious visitors into engaged readers/viewers. They know the problem — show them possibilities.
Content Types: Deep-dive blog posts, how-to guides, comparison articles, webinars, email newsletters, YouTube tutorials
CTAs: Subscribe, Download Free Guide, Join the Webinar, Watch the Full Video
Metrics: Time on page, pages per session, email signups, content downloads, webinar registrations, video completion rate
Channels: SEO (informational keywords), YouTube, email nurture, retargeting, LinkedIn content
Message Framework: Position yourself as the expert guide. Deliver genuine value. Capture email before they leave. Build trust.

Keywords: consideration evaluation comparison research alternatives solutions middle of funnel
Goal: They're actively evaluating solutions. Help them understand why you're the best fit.
Content Types: Case studies, comparison pages, product demos, free trials, email drip sequences, testimonials, ROI calculators
CTAs: See How It Works, Compare Plans, Watch Demo, Read Case Study
Metrics: Demo requests, trial signups, comparison page visits, email open rates (drip), time on pricing page
Channels: Email sequences, retargeting, LinkedIn (B2B), Google search ads (comparison keywords), review sites
Message Framework: Speak to their specific use case. Show proof with real results. Address top objections. Remove risk.

Keywords: intent purchase ready high intent trial request demo qualified leads bottom of funnel
Goal: Prospects are ready to decide. Your job is to make the decision easy and urgent.
Content Types: Free trial, product demo, sales call, ROI calculator, custom proposal, limited-time offer
CTAs: Start Free Trial, Book a Demo, Get a Quote, Talk to Sales
Metrics: Trial conversions, demo bookings, proposal requests, SQL (sales qualified leads), close rate
Channels: Email (intent triggers), retargeting (bottom of funnel ads), paid search (high-intent keywords), SDR outreach
Message Framework: Eliminate friction. Make the trial/demo feel risk-free. Use social proof from similar customers. Create urgency.

Keywords: evaluation decision objection handling pricing comparison proof ROI final decision close
Goal: They're comparing you vs. competitors. Address every objection and make you the obvious choice.
Content Types: Pricing page, detailed comparison page, case studies (industry-specific), security/compliance docs, pilot program, references
CTAs: Get Started, Choose Your Plan, Talk to an Expert, See Security Docs
Metrics: Win rate, demo-to-close rate, pricing page conversions, objection frequency, competitive win/loss
Channels: Sales calls, email follow-up, retargeting with testimonials, peer review sites (G2, Capterra), LinkedIn ads
Message Framework: Match messaging to their industry and role. Use ROI calculators. Reference specific competitors. Close objections proactively.

Keywords: purchase buy checkout conversion close won deal payment signup
Goal: Complete the transaction. Remove all friction from the buying moment.
Content Types: Checkout optimization, payment flexibility, onboarding preview, money-back guarantee, final offer email
CTAs: Buy Now, Complete Purchase, Activate My Account, Claim Discount
Metrics: Conversion rate, cart abandonment rate, checkout completion, revenue, average order value
Channels: Email (abandoned cart), retargeting, SMS (e-commerce), sales team (enterprise)
Message Framework: Make it dead simple. Show security badges. Offer payment flexibility. Reassure with guarantee. Thank immediately.

Keywords: onboarding activation first value aha moment retention setup success
Goal: Deliver the 'aha moment' quickly. Turn a new customer into an activated, engaged user.
Content Types: Welcome email sequence, in-app onboarding, tutorial videos, setup guide, success milestone emails
CTAs: Complete Your Profile, Set Up Your First [Thing], See Results Now
Metrics: Activation rate, time to first value, feature adoption, support ticket volume, 7-day retention
Channels: Email (welcome sequence), in-app messaging, support, onboarding calls (enterprise)
Message Framework: Celebrate their decision. Guide to first win ASAP. Remove setup friction. Make early success inevitable.

Keywords: retention churn reduce loyal customer lifetime value upsell engagement
Goal: Keep customers happy and using the product. Prevent churn. Grow account value.
Content Types: Monthly newsletter, product updates, customer success check-ins, exclusive content, loyalty rewards, NPS surveys
CTAs: Upgrade to Pro, Discover New Features, See What's New, Renew Now
Metrics: Churn rate, NPS score, feature adoption, renewal rate, customer lifetime value (LTV), support satisfaction
Channels: Email (retention), in-app, customer success team, community, SMS
Message Framework: Celebrate milestones. Proactively surface value. Connect features to their goals. Fix problems before they churn.

Keywords: advocacy referral word of mouth promoter NPS loyal fan ambassador review case study
Goal: Turn happy customers into brand advocates who recruit new customers for you.
Content Types: Referral program, review requests, case study invitations, community, affiliate program, user spotlights
CTAs: Share with a Friend, Leave a Review, Join Our Community, Become an Affiliate
Metrics: Referral signups, review count/rating, NPS (Promoter %), case study pipeline, community members
Channels: Email (referral ask), in-app (referral widget), community platform, social media
Message Framework: Ask at peak happiness. Make referring easy. Reward generously. Feature their success. Make them famous.

Keywords: re-engagement winback inactive churned lost customers lapsed dormant subscribers
Goal: Bring back dormant users or former customers who have gone quiet or cancelled.
Content Types: Win-back email sequence, special offer, product update announcement, personal check-in, exit survey follow-up
CTAs: We've Missed You, See What's New, Come Back for 50% Off, Tell Us What Happened
Metrics: Re-activation rate, win-back conversion rate, open rate on re-engagement emails, reason for churn
Channels: Email sequence, retargeting, sales outreach (enterprise), SMS
Message Framework: Be humble. Acknowledge the gap. Lead with value or an offer. Ask what went wrong. Make return easy.
